title: Stylish
description: A mod that adds new cosmetic effects to kills, elytras and chestplates
body:
# Made with mcreator

## Stylish is a Minecraft mod focused on small cosmetic features.
 Here's what's currently available
- Sound and visual effects after a kill
- Trails and Contrails after elytras
- visual ambient effects around the player

To apply effects, hold them in your offhand and the item to apply them to in your mainhand, and right-click.
- kill effects are applied to melee weapons
- elytra trails are applied to elytras
- Aura effects are applied to chestplates

Kill effects only work if the weapon is in your main hand while the entity dies.
The damage doesn't need to be from the weapon, but you need to be the source.

All effects can be duplicated by surrounding them with four of their material on a crafting table
- kill effects are duplicated with gold ingots
- elytra effects are duplicated with phantom membrane
- Aura effects are duplicated with lapis

_I totally don't encourage making particle bombs with this information_

**All effects are currently only available in the creative menu**
